benchmark_sources.Spambase: UCI 94, spambase.zip sha256 813ac1df..., label spam, PCA10 (unsupervised)
benchmark_sources.USPS: LIBSVM usps.bz2+usps.t.bz2 (CDALBench tabular task), label digit>=5, PCA10 (unsupervised)
benchmark_sources.BankMarketing: UCI 222 bank-full.csv, label subscription, 6 numeric covariates, duration excluded
benchmark_sources.excluded_by_user: biology and chemistry datasets (e.g. Splice/DNA) excluded at the user's request

study.prediction: registered before running: (i) the two cohorts with the lowest mean noise index (mean p_hat(1-p_hat) over candidates, computed from p_hat only) have a smaller mean floor share of the greedy-oracle gap than the other six; (ii) across the eight cohorts the floor share increases with the noise index (Spearman > 0); (iii) the closed-form bracket contains the measured group floor for every cohort and learner. Note: a seed-99001 smoke run showed USPS (PCA10, digit>=5) is not low-noise in this representation, so low-noise cohorts are defined by the index rather than named in advance.

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
